name: narrow seated chin up
description: A seated chin-up with a narrow underhand grip, using your legs for some help. It builds the lats and biceps.
instructions: Sit under a low bar with your hands close together, palms facing you.
Extend your legs in front with heels on the floor.
Pull your chest up toward the bar.
Squeeze your back and arms at the top.
Lower slowly until your arms are straight.
